feeding_claim.verbatim: Our 100% grass fed cows graze on native grasses deep in the Owyhee Mountain Range for eight months out of the year.

farmers_markets: Capital City Public Market, The Grove Plaza, Boise (April through December)
notes: Family ranch in the Owyhee Mountains at Oreana, southwest of Boise, found in the Idaho Beef Council producer directory. Checked 2026-11-15 the homepage, about and contact pages; the FAQ and shipping page failed to load. Orders go through a Barn2Door store; the site says it ships to the Lower 48 and delivers locally, without naming a delivery area, and sells at the Capital City Public Market in Boise from April through December. The site says the cows are 100% grass fed and graze native range eight months a year, but does not describe finishing or winter feed, so the category stays grass-fed. The site calls the beef USDA certified grass-fed; the USDA list could not be opened, so no certification was added. No phone and no quarter or half beef found.
